data_findings.lineage_policy: PRETRAIN_REAL and PRETRAIN_SYNTHETIC may train; VALIDATION selects checkpoints; FINAL_TEST and OOD_TEST are promotion-only and blocked from training access
data_findings.normalization_policy: normalization/statistics artifacts must be derived from PRETRAIN_* only

required_provenance.license_usage_notes: record upstream model/data license and Conrad usage decision
required_provenance.import_transform: record key mapping and patch-projection transform if any

initialization_findings.sonar_policy: sonar patch projection may be independently initialized or transformed from RGB only with an explicit transform digest; transformer weights may inherit generic RGB initialization, after which sonar independence is established by U1-SONAR-RESEARCH data, metrics, and separate checkpoint ancestry

compute_findings.parameter_count_status: verified from prior P4.6 smoke report and bounded here as approx current J1 scale
compute_findings.recommended_gpu_count: 1 for U1 debug/research slices; 2-4+ for M1/T1/J1 throughput and reproducibility sweeps
compute_findings.precision: BF16 preferred; FP16 with GradScaler fallback; FP32 CPU/dev only
compute_findings.storage: >=500 GB working dataset/checkpoint space; keep top-k plus last checkpoints and immutable metadata

estimates.U1: single-modality ViT-S class run: 16-24 GB minimum, 40-80 GB recommended
estimates.M1: multimodal fusion: 24-40 GB minimum, 80 GB recommended
estimates.T1: temporal windows add activation pressure: 40 GB minimum, 80 GB recommended
estimates.J1: full joint ~153M params plus multimodal activations: 40 GB minimum, 80 GB+ recommended

determinism_findings.same_environment_resume: exact deterministic resume required in compatible same hardware/software environment
determinism_findings.cross_hardware: bitwise equality across hardware is not promised
determinism_findings.formal_mode: prefer deterministic kernels; document and approve any FlashAttention-style exception

observability_requirements: bytes moved where available and VRAM
modality mix, missingness, PairGraph coverage, temporal coverage
abstract profiling contracts only; no proprietary accelerator microarchitecture disclosures

representation_health.rank_note: effective rank >=64 is evaluated only when min(n_independent, representation_dim) >=64; otherwise the guard is NOT_EVALUABLE and cannot promote a checkpoint

promotion_rules: required objective sets are fixed per stage; NOT_APPLICABLE objectives do not improve val_ssl_total
objective coverage thresholds must be met before a checkpoint can be selected
parent checkpoint path, checkpoint_id, component, content digest, config digest, split hash, and git SHA are recorded
formal acceptance requires a clean committed tree
J1-RESEARCH top checkpoint becomes OSFM-S-PRETRAIN-V1-CANDIDATE only; OSFM-FQ produces OSFM-S-PRETRAIN-V1
osfm_fq_confirmation: B0 scratch vs B1 generic init vs B2 full OS-FM
downstream transfer: detection, segmentation, anomaly, condition cues
>=5 downstream seeds for final comparisons; >=3 pretraining seeds target
missing modality, robustness/corruption, temporal contribution, OOD, synthetic usefulness, objective/fusion/adapter ablations
public-real evidence required before stronger validation claims
previous internal engineering thresholds remain frozen unless separately flagged as blockers
